release_status_explanation: Local research package is complete and validated for manual upload. Full-wave adjoint electromagnetics, measured material constants, sensor-noise characterization and experiments remain untested; remote commit/CI verification is intentionally not run because the author requested manual upload.
next_research_gate: Implement source-term-consistent Maxwell FDTD/FEM with adjoint gradients; benchmark isolated spheres against Mie/analytic limits; verify gradients by finite differences; add measured cryogenic dielectric constants and a sensor-specific noise/collection model; then test a disorder ensemble and hold-out geometries.
